purpose: Non-admission research registration of the exact official Berlin ALKIS building WFS product already tested in a bounded fixed five-feature canary; source-derived footprint staging and CAT4 discovery metadata remain strictly separate.

entries.name: Berlin ALKIS official buildings WFS (monthly mutable)
entries.provider: Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen Berlin
entries.spatial_scope: Berlin, Germany; official cadastral building and building-part WFS; one fixed 200 m by 200 m research bbox verified
entries.temporal_scope: Current mutable WFS, updated monthly; original per-building validity and 2021 presence unknown; research receipt 2026-11-01
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Individual source Polygon/MultiPolygon features in requested EPSG:25833; fixed five-feature anonymous sample; no complete census
entries.note: Official provider catalogue states Datenlizenz Deutschland Zero 2.0 for the published layer; confirm feature/derivative scope and any attribute restrictions before scaled reuse. Existing source-specific fixed WFS GetCapabilities and five-feature GetFeature canaries verified five source polygons in Berlin DE3, with checksum and original-source geography. The optional BLD4 SQLite stores source-derived polygons and aggregate provenance only; it is NOT the CAT4 source research registry and not a policy, insured location, 2021 building census, building age, replacement value, independent hazard validation, or CAT model input. Preserve monthly update identity, source SHA/time, EPSG:25833, CAT1/CAT2 2021 boundary vintage, and the no-admission boundary.
